desc: Ideation: reduce the problem to finding the longest prefix of reversed S that is also a suffix of S.
Implement the final Python program using KMP prefix function on R = S[::-1] and a KMP scan over S, taking the final state as l and printing S + S[:n-l][::-1].
Verify edge cases and performance: single character, already palindrome, all same letters, non-palindrome, and n = 500000 within O(n) time/memory.
